description: Plan de Protección Civil de Talavera is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by talavera.ddl.net. The Talavera Civil Protection Plan is the cartographic instrument that allows us to know and assess the existing risks in the municipality of Talavera, so that we can establish action protocols when these give rise to an emergency situation. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Talavera Civil Protection Plan" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Municipality, Catalunya, Emergency, Cataluña, Spain, Municipios. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
